description: Turns a design brief into a short list of references (default 8, at most 10), each with `why` it fits: the pattern, style, category, technology or platform it shares with the brief, or how search matched it (e.g. "similar meaning"). It reads the brief against Tangent's taxonomy and synonyms and combines that with search; no AI calls. Use it when someone describes a screen or product they are about to design. `interpreted_as` shows how the brief was read. Example: {"brief": "onboarding for a fintech app, playful but clean", "platform": "mobile"}

brief.description: What you are designing, in plain words, e.g. "onboarding for a fintech app, playful but clean".

platform.description: Prefer resources for this platform: "web", "mobile" or "desktop".

name: find_inspiration

interpreted_as.description: Taxonomy terms read from the brief.

image_url.description: Full-size preview (screenshot, else the site's OG image): the stored image file, served directly.

open_source.description: true: OSI-licensed; false: source-available or closed; null when unknown.

pricing.description: free, freemium, paid or open_source; null when unknown.

site_url.description: The site's own address, untagged. Use it to compare, dedupe or cite.

thumbnail_url.description: A smaller stored copy of image_url (a screenshot's 720px-wide WebP) when one exists; otherwise the same URL as image_url.

url.description: Visit link for the site (tagged utm_source=tangent-mcp). Use this one when linking people to the site.

why.description: Reasons for the pick, e.g. "pattern: Onboarding", "style: Playful", "similar meaning".

title: Find inspiration for a brief
